results.name: create_page_default
results.doc:
A brief naming no sections gets a page composed for the business: hero,
    benefits, testimonials and an FAQ are always there, and it runs to between
    five and nine sections -- every run.

results.name: create_page_named_sections
results.doc: Asking for a hero and an FAQ produces exactly those two sections.

results.name: create_page_promotion_cue
results.doc:
A described offer counts as naming a section: it becomes a promotion,
    and no extra sections are invented alongside it.

results.name: create_page_collision
results.doc:
A second page for the same business takes its own URL and leaves the
    published original untouched.

results.name: reject_unsupported_intent
results.doc: A request that is not about a page is refused and stores nothing.

results.name: reject_unclear_command
results.doc: Silence transcribed into filler is refused before any model runs.

results.name: edit_headline
results.doc:
Changing text leaves the structure alone: same sections, same URL, and
    the page is still a draft.

results.name: add_section
results.doc:
A new section lands in canonical order without being told where to go --
    the user asked for testimonials, not for a layout.

results.name: remove_section
results.doc: Removal leaves a valid page behind, not an empty one.

results.name: set_theme
results.doc:
Recolouring a page gives it a palette and touches nothing else: same
    sections, same URL, still a draft.

results.name: replace_image
results.doc:
Swapping a photo leaves the page's shape alone: the same sections, the
    same entries, still a draft.

results.name: set_variant
results.doc: A layout change lands on the named section only; nothing else moves.

results.name: move_section
results.doc:
Moving a section reorders the page without adding, dropping or editing
    anything.

results.name: rewrite_reviews
results.doc:
Asking for the reviews to be written again keeps the page's structure;
    what the reviews say is the model's, and is judged elsewhere.

results.name: create_page_default
results.doc:
Each section is written, illustrated and validated before the page is
    assembled, and nothing is persisted until it clears the schema gate.

results.name: create_page_collision
results.doc:
The colliding page is persisted under the suffixed URL, and only after
    it has been validated.

results.name: create_page_named_sections
results.doc:
Only the two requested sections are generated -- no work is done for
    sections the user never asked for.

results.name: create_page_promotion_cue
results.doc: The described offer is planned and built as a promotion section.

results.name: reject_unsupported_intent
results.doc: A refused request must not reach generation or persistence at all.

results.name: reject_unclear_command
results.doc:
An unusable transcript is stopped before any model is called, so the
    refusal costs nothing.

results.name: edit_headline
results.doc:
An edit reads the page, changes it, re-validates it, and only then
    stores it. Skipping the re-validation would let an edit persist something
    the generator could never have produced.

results.name: set_theme
results.doc:
A recolour is a generation step like any other: the palette is chosen,
    applied, and re-validated with the page before it is stored.

results.name: add_section
results.doc:
Adding a section writes only that section, without re-planning the page
    or picking a palette again.

results.name: remove_section
results.doc: Removing a section generates nothing: load, remove, validate, store.

results.name: replace_image
results.doc: A new photo is retrieved for the named section and nothing is written.

results.name: set_variant
results.doc: A layout change touches no model at all.

results.name: move_section
results.doc: Reordering touches no model at all.

results.name: add_item
results.doc: A new entry is a structural edit, not a generation.

results.name: remove_item
results.doc: Removing an entry touches no model at all.

results.name: move_item
results.doc: Reordering entries touches no model at all.

results.name: set_icon
results.doc: One icon is looked up for the named section; no copy is written.

results.name: rewrite_reviews
results.doc:
A rewrite writes and validates the one section, without re-planning the
    page or choosing a palette, and stores only after the page validates.

results.name: create_page_default

Intent, brief, layout and photo are each judged on their own, across
    every way of phrasing the same request.

results.name: image_recall_at_5
results.doc:
The right kind of photo for a business, judged by category: several
    library photos are usually equally correct for one query, so scoring
    against one chosen file would understate real retrieval quality.

    The queries are written as real hero copy and deliberately never name the
    trade -- "burst pipe at midnight", not "plumber" -- so this measures whether
    retrieval understands the business, not whether it can match a keyword.
    Report target: Recall@5 >= 0.70.

Dictated edits: which section, which line or entry, and the exact words.
    Report target: slot accuracy >= 0.80.
